fields.subject: Mapping Expression Builders
fields.condition: the property being written to an input string parameter is an enum type or a nullable enum type
fields.trigger: an input string parameter expression is built for that property
fields.response: convert the property's enum value to its string representation via Enum.ToString before passing it to the provider's add-parameter method, substituting a null string constant when a nullable enum property currently has no value
fields.postcondition: a non-enum string property is passed to the add-parameter method unconverted
